answer: Before the challenge opens, every key seals its own policy: a rule for how it will answer anything. Payout goes only to work that sealed rule could have produced. The commitment is a willow, bending to each prompt without breaking shape, and two keys whose answers land within a hair of one another are the same hand, paid once. A farm cannot forge many heads cheaply: each new one must stay far from all the others in output space, and the room left for the last shrinks as earlier heads claim it. Cost per clone rises with the count. That spacing is the tundra, wide and bare; nothing hides in it.
